name: Mall Directory Standee
summary: A slim double-sided atrium directory with blank backlit panels and unlabelled locator dots.
description: Original free-standing deep jade directory standee with two warm ivory emissive blank panels, plain locator dots, champagne trim, a slim weighted base and a small top light bar. No text, map artwork, logos or external assets.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / Codex-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and three shared Principled BSDF materials; no external assets, fonts, images or textures.
accuracy_notes: Measured from the exported GLB; metrics dimensions use X width, Y height, Z depth. Panels are deliberately blank except for plain locator dots. Static emissive appearance only; no real map, touchscreen, navigation, runtime light sources or electrical simulation. Physical stability, physical Android/iOS, WebKit and performance in the full mall have not been verified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and materials authored for the owner project; no third-party assets.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
